versions.content: If a change to the LIN hardware control registers results in the need to wait for a status change, this shal l be protected by a configurable time out mechanism (LinTimeoutDuration). If such a time out is detected the LIN_E_TIMEOUT error shall be raised to the DET or DEM . This situation should only arise in the ev en t of a LIN hardware unit fault, and should be communicated to the rest of the system.
